variables.description: The opening scene has played — set once, so it does not replay on re-entry.
Established that Vane was poisoned rather than struck.
Identified the poison specifically as foxglove — the detail only a careful examination yields.
Noticed that a page has been torn out of Vane's assessment ledger.
Noticed the wet bootprints leading from the yard door.
Learned that Vane's assessment would have taken the inn for arrears.
Learned that Wren was dismissed from Vane's service.
Learned that Vane seized Calloway's cargo at the Kelder toll.
Wren admitted he crossed the yard in the night.
Named Aldous Wren to the militia.
Named Sera Bragg to the militia.
Named Maud Calloway to the militia.
Let dawn come without naming anyone.
Hard facts established. The militia will not act on fewer than three.
What you gave as your name when Bragg asked. Substituted into later lines as {investigator_name}.
